notes: Web fetch was blocked for every host in this session; all figures come from search-result extracts of the cited pages. Each URL is the page the figure was quoted from.

NBS 'average wage' is the total wage bill per employee: it already contains overtime pay, bonuses and allowances. Recruiter (jobui / job5156) monthly figures are posted 'comprehensive' pay, usually including overtime but not the year-end bonus — they are ×13.

Fully-loaded rates exclude meal/dorm allowances, training, absenteeism and severance accruals (none sourced). Social insurance is charged at the contribution floor (common practice for hourly staff); full legal compliance (base = actual pay incl. overtime) would add roughly 24.8% × (actual − floor) for Guangdong/Chongqing/Wuhan staff, e.g. semiskilled: four-cluster mean (actual − floor) ≈ 1,400 CNY/month → +4,166 CNY/yr ≈ +¥1.3/h in the 2×12 h model.

Current book vs evidence: semiskilled ¥49.91/h vs derived ¥30–32; skilled ¥71.75 vs ¥32–33; engineer ¥163.39 vs ¥99; foundry ¥45.38 vs proxy ¥30–32; electronics ¥58.96 vs ¥32–33; supervisor ¥96.88 vs ¥38–41; technician ¥78.85 vs ¥37–40; inspector ¥72.64 vs ¥30–31 (weak).

Gas: current book ¥0.27/kWh is below every 2026 cluster price found (¥0.31–0.41 ex-VAT) and below the national 36-city industrial average (¥0.328). Electricity: current ¥0.63 sits between the national proxy ex-VAT (0.594) and incl.-VAT (0.672) values; not shown wrong.

Not found: per-city wages for Chongqing and Wuhan by role, foundry / forge / furnace / plastics / router operator wages, 2026 social-insurance bases for Chongqing, Wuhan, Suzhou, Ningbo and Dongguan, Shenzhen/Dongguan medical rates, Guangdong unemployment rate, provincial all-in electricity averages for Shanghai, Jiangsu, Guangdong and Hubei, 2026 Guangdong gas prices.
